Hi Kate —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. As discussed, we want to get a short MAP (mutual action plan) kickoff on the calendar so we can align stakeholders, walk through the evaluation plan, and confirm the close timeline target (target close: end of Q2).

Proposed options (60 min):

- Wed Mar 31, 09:00–10:00 PT
- Thu Apr 1, 11:00–12:00 PT

1) Introductions & roles (10m) — confirm primary technical, business, procurement contacts
2) MAP overview & milestone calendar (15m) — evaluation tests, success criteria, gating items
3) Ops/logistics (10m) — Zoom, access, data handling, evaluation infra
4) Next steps & ownership (10m)
5) Q&A (15m)

Attachments: MAP_Playbook_v1.pdf (playbook + evaluation plan), Kickoff_Agenda_Draft.md, Calendar_Hold_MAP_Kickoff.ics

Zoom (provisional): https://zoom.us/j/1234567890?pwd=playbook

Marissa will be our MAP lead and will run the agenda. Stephanie will coordinate eval test access and any procurement artifacts.

Thanks —
